newsitem.title: USA: Duke restores service to more than 426,000.
newsitem.headline: Duke restores service to more than 426,000.

text.p: Duke Power Co said Thursday it has returned power service to more than 426,000 North Carolina customers out of a total of 431,000 affected by last week's Hurricane Fran.

"Duke hopes to restore service to most of the fewer than 5,000 customers still without power from Hurricane Fran, though some scattered outages may persist through the end of the week," the company said in a statement at 0700 EDT.
Most of these outages were in Durham, N.C., where about 2,500 electricity users were still without power.
An additional 2,000 customers were without service in Chapel Hill, N.C., while in Burlington, there were 200 customers without service.
